column2: [intro]
When you get up in the morning, say hello to the sun
And even if it rains, act as if it's summer
In your mismatched socks, you're the coolest
Nothing stops you, you're a real fool
It's a matter of intention, my friend
Everything is in the way you smile
Life is too short to be serious
So do your best, yeah yeah yeah

It doesn't matter if you're not the best soprano
Your imaginary audience goes wild, clapping loudly
You're the star of the moment, the mic is your treasure
It's a matter of intention, my dear
Don't overthink it, let go of your worries
Dance like nobody's watching
And make your life a party, yeah yeah yeah
